item_description: Edward Elric is a young State Alchemist from Fullmetal Alchemist who travels with his brother Alphonse to find a way to restore their bodies. He is known for fast, inventive alchemy and a strong determination to protect others.
item_facts: He is known as the Fullmetal Alchemist.
He lost his right arm and left leg in a failed human transmutation.
Automail prosthetics replace his missing limbs.
He can perform alchemy without drawing a transmutation circle after making a human transmutation attempt.

item_description: Eren Yeager is a central character in Attack on Titan whose determination to fight the Titans drives much of the story. His role and motivations change dramatically as the conflict expands.
item_facts: He grew up in Shiganshina District.
He gains the power of the Attack Titan.
He later also inherits the Founding Titan and the War Hammer Titan.
His childhood friends include Mikasa Ackerman and Armin Arlert.

item_description: Satoru Gojo is a powerful jujutsu sorcerer and teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High in Jujutsu Kaisen. His unusual abilities make him a major force against curses.
item_facts: He possesses the Limitless cursed technique.
The Six Eyes greatly enhance his perception and control of cursed energy.
His Domain Expansion is called Unlimited Void.
He teaches first-year students including Yuji Itadori.

item_description: Goku is the main hero of Dragon Ball, a Saiyan raised on Earth who trains constantly and protects the planet from powerful threats. His cheerful nature and love of fighting shape many of his adventures.
item_facts: His Saiyan birth name is Kakarot.
He was sent to Earth as a baby from Planet Vegeta.
He first becomes a Super Saiyan during the battle with Frieza.
His signature techniques include the Kamehameha and Spirit Bomb.

item_description: Gon Freecss is the young protagonist of Hunter × Hunter who becomes a Hunter while searching for his father, Ging. He is energetic, determined and naturally talented in combat.
item_facts: He comes from Whale Island.
His father, Ging Freecss, is a renowned Hunter.
His Nen type is Enhancement.
His signature attack is the Jajanken.

item_description: Ichigo Kurosaki is the protagonist of Bleach, a teenager who gains Soul Reaper powers and protects people from hostile spirits. His journey connects the human world with the spiritual realms.
item_facts: He receives Soul Reaper powers from Rukia Kuchiki.
His Zanpakutō is named Zangetsu.
He can use Bankai, called Tensa Zangetsu.
His heritage connects several different spiritual lineages.

item_description: Itachi Uchiha is a highly skilled shinobi from the Uchiha clan in Naruto. His actions are initially presented as those of a villain, but the story later reveals more about his motives and sacrifices.
item_facts: He is the older brother of Sasuke Uchiha.
He awakened the Sharingan and later the Mangekyō Sharingan.
His abilities include Tsukuyomi and Amaterasu.
He was a member of the criminal organization Akatsuki.

item_description: Kakashi Hatake is a veteran shinobi from Konohagakure in Naruto and the leader of Team 7. Known for his calm tactics, he teaches Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura.
item_facts: He is widely known as the Copy Ninja.
He received his Sharingan from Obito Uchiha.
His signature technique is the Lightning Blade, also called Chidori.
He later becomes the Sixth Hokage.

item_description: Killua Zoldyck is a young Hunter × Hunter character born into a famous family of assassins. He becomes Gon Freecss's close friend and combines exceptional speed with electrical Nen abilities.
item_facts: He is a member of the Zoldyck assassin family.
He befriends Gon during the Hunter Exam.
His Nen ability includes transforming aura into electricity.
Godspeed is one of his advanced techniques.

item_description: L Lawliet is the brilliant, eccentric detective in Death Note who works to uncover the identity of the mysterious killer known as Kira. He relies on deduction, unconventional methods and careful psychological strategy.
item_facts: He is known publicly by the initial L.
He investigates the deaths caused by the Death Note.
He often sits in a crouched position and has a distinctive sweet tooth.
He works with the Japanese task force investigating Kira.

item_description: Levi Ackerman is a captain in the Survey Corps in Attack on Titan, renowned for his exceptional combat skill and discipline. He plays a key role in humanity's fight against the Titans.
item_facts: He is often called humanity's strongest soldier.
He is exceptionally skilled with vertical maneuvering equipment.
He comes from the Ackerman family.
He serves under Commander Erwin Smith for much of the story.

item_description: Light Yagami is a highly intelligent student in Death Note who discovers a supernatural notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written in it. He adopts the identity Kira and becomes the focus of a global investigation.
item_facts: He finds the Death Note dropped by the shinigami Ryuk.
The notebook's rules allow a person to be killed by writing their name.
He becomes locked in a battle of wits with detective L.
His father, Soichiro Yagami, is a senior police officer.

item_description: Monkey D. Luffy is the captain of the Straw Hat Pirates in One Piece and dreams of becoming the Pirate King. His rubber-like body and fearless loyalty help him build a powerful crew.
item_facts: He ate the Devil Fruit originally called the Gum-Gum Fruit.
His crew is known as the Straw Hat Pirates.
He seeks the legendary treasure called the One Piece.
His signature techniques include Gear transformations.

item_description: Naruto Uzumaki is the central hero of Naruto, a young ninja who strives to earn recognition and become Hokage. He carries the Nine-Tailed Fox, Kurama, sealed within him for much of his life.
item_facts: He is from Konohagakure, the Hidden Leaf Village.
He learns the Rasengan from Jiraiya.
He can use Shadow Clone Technique.
He eventually becomes the Seventh Hokage.

item_description: Roronoa Zoro is the swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates in One Piece, aiming to become the world's greatest swordsman. He is known for his immense endurance and three-sword fighting style.
item_facts: He uses the Three-Sword Style, or Santoryu.
He joins Luffy near the beginning of the journey.
One of his notable swords is Wado Ichimonji.
He trained under Dracule Mihawk during the two-year time skip.

item_description: Saitama is the central character of One-Punch Man, a hero who has become so powerful that most opponents are defeated with a single punch. His overwhelming strength contrasts with his ordinary daily concerns.
item_facts: He began hero work as a hobby.
He is known for his plain appearance and bald head.
He is registered with the Hero Association.
Genos becomes his disciple.

item_description: Sasuke Uchiha is a gifted shinobi from Naruto's Uchiha clan whose pursuit of power and revenge shapes his story. He is Naruto Uzumaki's rival and eventually an important ally.
item_facts: He is the younger brother of Itachi Uchiha.
He awakens the Sharingan as a child.
He later gains the Rinnegan in one eye.
His signature techniques include Chidori and its variations.

item_description: Spike Spiegel is the laid-back bounty hunter at the centre of Cowboy Bebop. A former member of the Red Dragon crime syndicate, he travels through space with the crew of the Bebop.
item_facts: He is a skilled martial artist and gunfighter.
He pilots the Swordfish II spacecraft.
His past is closely tied to Vicious and the Red Dragon Syndicate.
The series blends science fiction, noir and jazz influences.

item_description: Tanjiro Kamado is the protagonist of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba, who joins the Demon Slayer Corps after his family is attacked and his sister Nezuko is turned into a demon. He is known for empathy, determination and keen senses.
item_facts: He initially trains in Water Breathing.
He later uses techniques associated with Hinokami Kagura.
His sense of smell is exceptionally acute.
His sister Nezuko travels with him in a protective box.

item_description: Vegeta is a Saiyan prince in Dragon Ball who begins as an antagonist before becoming one of Earth's defenders. His pride, fierce rivalry with Goku and relentless training define his character.
item_facts: He is the prince of the Saiyan race.
He is initially an enemy of Goku and the Z Fighters.
He achieves the Super Saiyan transformation.
He later marries Bulma and has children, including Trunks and Bulla.
